data.title: Utility statement 2024/25 – €184.20 due
data.summary: Muster Apartments GmbH sent its utility statement for 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2025, dated 3 November 2025. Your advance payments fell short of the actual costs, leaving a balance of €184.20 to pay within 30 days of the statement date.
data.explanation: Your landlord has settled the heating and hot water costs for the past year. Actual costs were €1,624.20 and you paid €1,440.00 in advance, so you owe the difference of €184.20. Pay it to the bank account on the letter within 30 days of the statement date (the app shows the exact date). The letter gives no objection procedure or deadline. If the figures look wrong, ask the landlord for the itemised statement and supporting documents before or soon after paying. A tenant advice service (Mieterverein) can help check it.
